Speak to [[Headmaster Kaa]] to begin your [[mesmer]] training.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Mesmer
| primary = y
}}

===Objectives===
* Talk to Ludo to gain entrance to the monastery.
* Seek out [[Headmaster Kaa]] in the monastery. 

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 20 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Speak to Ludo at the entrance to Shing Jea Monastery to enter. If you skipped the tutorial [[Mantid Hatchlings]], you will learn the [[skill]]s
* {{skill icon|Empathy}}
* {{skill icon|Ether Feast}}
* {{skill icon|Resurrection Signet}}
gain 2,000 experience, and acquire a [[Starter Cane]] after entering the monastery. You would have already received these if you did the tutorial. Speak to Headmaster Kaa, who is nearby, for your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Ludo'''
:''"Hello, young Mesmer! I am happy to enroll you in the monastery so you can begin your training. Seek out '''Headmaster Kaa''', the Mesmer headmaster. He is here in the '''monastery'''. Enjoy your first day!"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll seek out Headmaster Kaa.
| decline = I'm going to have a look around, first.
| ask = '''Headmaster Kaa''' should be here in the monastery. I told him of your arrival, so he will be waiting for you.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Headmaster Kaa'''
:''"That Ludo is an interesting fellow, is he not? He has stood at our gates these twenty years."''

==Notes==
*If you abandon this quest, it cannot be retaken, but you can take the following quest immediately.
